hooks.name: Keeper of the Light Continuity Check
hooks.description: Example album hook. Copy to .kiro/hooks/keeper-of-the-light-continuity.json and adjust the matcher to your song folders. Fires when an agent saves a Keeper of the Light song file and checks it against the blueprint's 12 hard rules.

action.prompt: A Keeper of the Light song file was just saved. Read examples/albums/keeper-of-the-light/BLUEPRINT.md (Track Registry and the 12 HARD RULES; use your own copy of the blueprint if you made one) and check the saved song against every rule. In particular: the sea is audible in every track; D Mixolydian only in T1 and T8; F minor only in T7; no distortion/effects before T3; 'the light keeps' only in T1, T3, T5 and T8, with a different meaning each time; the creature is never named; no harmony vocals before T7; T6 is the quietest track; concertina only in T1, T2 and T8; T8 tempo matches T1 (92 BPM); no two adjacent tracks share more than 70% of their palette; nothing after T5 is louder than the storm. Report a PASS/FAIL table with a fix for each FAIL.
